title: Route the scattered UTF-16 sort comparators through textutil::code_unit_cmp — pure dedup, zero behavior change
action: jp-5 consolidated truncation helpers into crates/bee/src/textutil.rs and moved code_unit_cmp (UTF-16 code-unit ordering, kept for release-manifest byte-reproduction) there. Still scattered: hand-inlined `.encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<u16>>().cmp(...)`-style comparators in verbs/knowledge/promote.rs (compare_cell_ids / sort_utf16, ~3 spots), verbs/reservations/leases.rs (~2), verbs/state_group/flags.rs (~2), verbs/cells/validate.rs (~2), verbs/cells/schedule.rs (~4), verbs/cells/util.rs (~2) — re-grep `encode_utf16` outside textutil.rs for the authoritative list. REPLACE each inline comparator body with a call to textutil's code_unit_cmp (or js_default_sort where the callsite sorts a Vec<String>), keeping the EXACT same ordering semantics — this is dedup only; sort order must not change. Delete the now-empty local helpers (e.g. promote.rs sort_utf16) once their bodies route through textutil. If any site's comparator differs semantically from code_unit_cmp (not just syntactically), leave it and report it — do not force it through.
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml green from the worktree; rg encode_utf16 outside textutil.rs returns zero hits or only reported-and-justified sites

truths: every UTF-16 sort comparator routes through textutil (or is reported as semantically distinct)
sort order provably unchanged: full suite green with no test edits

trace.outcome: Routed all scattered UTF-16 sort comparators (8 predecessor files + feedback.rs found on re-grep) through textutil::code_unit_cmp/js_default_sort; zero encode_utf16 hits remain outside textutil.rs; worktree cargo test --release green: 1004 passed/0 failed/3 ignored plus all integration suites 0 failed
